title: Calling a name that does not exist
prompt: solve calls a helper called `beep`, but the helper below is named `bleep`. Godot cannot find beep. Make the two names match so the output is "beep". Change only the helper's name.
hints: A call only works if a function with exactly that name exists.
The error names the function it could not find.
Rename bleep to beep in the definition.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.
